candidates.rationale: pilot recipe that measured 2.70% at 10k: standardized inputs, dropout 0.3, noise 0.3 SD
pilot 10k recipe: 3x1024, mixup 0.4, label smoothing 0.05, lr 3e-3, bs 256, 200 epochs
round-1 leader at 1k (ladder-retuned-tq, 5.50%) was truncated at 10k with batch 100 (3.9 s/epoch); batch 250 fits 300 epochs in the 20-minute budget

notes: Second development round (2026-09-23, after the first round showed the 4x-normalized noise 1.2 MLPs at ~7% error, i.e. over-regularised). The literature agent's pilot standardized each feature to unit variance with training-set statistics (std floor 1e-5) before adding noise 0.3; these candidates reproduce that convention via the new normalization=standardize option. Round-1 results remain in the dev table. TRIMMED 2026-09-24 to four candidates because the upper-envelope ledger had $8.78 left after round 1; the dropped variants (noise/width/EMA/long/VAT) are listed in plans/candidates_b_full.json. VAT was dropped because all four round-1 VAT arms collapsed to a constant class on the A100 while identical configs train normally on CPU at short horizons; see research notes.
